title: B7 Authenticated UDP 9092 Discovery Handshake Call-Site Parity in susi-gawd and susi-gawd-swarm
goal: Retire unauthenticated SUSI_LAN_PING call sites in crates/susi-gawd/src/kernel_loader.rs and crates/susi-gawd-swarm/src/amas.rs by implementing probe_udp_discovery_port (sending SUSI_PING:<token> and verifying SUSI_ACK: reply) and authenticated_lan_ping_frame (emitting SUSI_PING:<token> only when a non-empty host token is seeded).
